dialogue.text: Hey kid, lovely night out today. I am just about to head out for a smoke.

options.text: Before you go, can I ask you some things?
Are there any phone numbers helpful in an earthquake?

dialogue.text: You can call 119 in an emergency for an ambulance or the fire department. This is the most important during disasters like these.
Another important number is 110 for the police.
You can leave a voice message or listen to voice messages from friends with the Disaster Line 171.
